integrity: All original assertions are supported by an explicit proof in RESULT.md and reproducible finite diagnostics; numerical checks do not stand in for infinite-time arguments.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns independent unconfined one-dimensional Brownian particles under simultaneous current-maximum Poisson resetting and first-particle absorption. The explicit capture-probability bound is not sharp. It does not address confinement, conditional passage time, alternative group-arrival criteria or non-Poisson reset clocks. Prior-art priority remains subject to unindexed or inaccessible equivalent papers.
title: Positive escape probability for every positive maximum-group reset rate in unconfined Brownian search
